title: Cipher Workbench
hook: Spin the wheel. Read the shape of a secret.
outcome: Explore six historical cipher methods and investigate the patterns they reveal with five working analysis instruments.
sources: Suetonius, Julius 32 and 56: https://penelope.uchicago.edu/Thayer/E/Roman/Texts/Suetonius/12Caesars/Julius*.html ; public-domain Loeb translation. Checked against Gutenberg 6400. Historical phrase and shift only.

James Leeson: https://registers.trinitywallstreet.org/churchyard/history.php?id=350 ; facts only, modern prose not reused. Inscription and three-grid key: Charles Hemstreet, Nooks and Corners of Old New York (1899), public-domain original; independently checked against the printed inscription.

Poe, The Gold-Bug: https://www.gutenberg.org/ebooks/2147 ; public domain in the USA as stated on its ebook page. Whole original cryptogram and its plaintext. Checked against https://eapoe.org/works/tales/goldbgb.htm (1845 Tales); editorial prose not bundled.

Vicksburg 1863 original dispatch: https://acwm.org/wp-content/uploads/magazine_message_in_a_bottle_article.pdf ; historical original public domain; no contemporary prose or images reused. Independently checked against https://fohbc.org/wp-content/uploads/2012/12/CivilWarMessageInABottle_MayJune2011.pdf . Ciphertext recomputed using MANCHESTERBLUFF.

Enigma I factual wirings and notches: https://www.cryptomuseum.com/crypto/enigma/wiring.htm ; factual values only, no prose, images or source code copied. Checked against University of Amsterdam FEIOG construction and operation description.
1930 example exclusion: https://cryptocellar.org/enigma/e-message-1930.html ; factual reflector-A identification, original ciphertext excluded from the B-only instrument.

English ghost: https://norvig.com/mayzner.html ; 26 factual percentages provided in spec. No copyrighted prose, corpus or software imported; no licence grant found for corpus and corpus is not bundled.
Shannon 1949, Communication Theory of Secrecy Systems, doi:10.1002/j.1538-7305.1949.tb00928.x ; theorem paraphrased, no article text reused.
NIST FIPS 197 https://csrc.nist.gov/pubs/fips/197/final ; US government public-domain specification, factual AES key count only.

Four original practice sheets and 26 drawn substitution shapes: Curio Class owner spec at fefed72e. Exact original texts retained. All computed ciphertext, coincidence indices, gap counts and key counts generated in the instrument. No external dataset sampled.

Additional historical facts only, original summaries: Suetonius Augustus 88 (public-domain Loeb translation, AA for X; older translation differs); Kerckhoffs La cryptographie militaire 1883 (public-domain original, BnF catalogue); Al-Kadi 1992 and Broemeling 2011 doi:10.1198/tas.2011.10191 (facts paraphrased, article text not reused); NSA/CIA Venona histories (US government public domain); Lasry et al. 2023 doi:10.1080/01611194.2022.2160677, institutional discovery account and National Diet Library notice (facts only); National Library of Scotland and National Museums Scotland (Mary trial and execution facts only).
Augustus 88: https://penelope.uchicago.edu/Thayer/E/Roman/Texts/Suetonius/12Caesars/Augustus*.html ; public-domain Loeb translation, factual attribution checked 2026-11-05.
Kerckhoffs 1883: https://www.petitcolas.net/kerckhoffs/crypto_militaire_1_b.pdf ; public-domain original, second desideratum; publication checked in BnF catalogue.
Al-Kadi 1992 doi:10.1080/0161-119291866801 and Broemeling doi:10.1198/tas.2011.10191 ; historical facts paraphrased, no licensed article text imported.

Venona: https://www.nsa.gov/Portals/70/documents/news-features/declassified-documents/crypto-almanac-50th/VENONA_An_Overview.pdf and https://www.cia.gov/resources/csi/static/Venona-Soviet-Espionage-and-the-American-Response-1939-1957.pdf ; US government public-domain histories; facts paraphrased.

Mary discovery: doi:10.1080/01611194.2022.2160677 ; institutional verification https://ats.org/explore/articles/secret-historical-letters-decoded/ and https://current.ndl.go.jp/car/173231 ; facts only, no article text or images imported.

Mary trial/execution: https://www.nls.uk/collections/stories/scottish-history/mary-queen-of-scots-last-letter/ and https://www.nms.ac.uk/discover-catalogue/life-and-deathline-of-mary-queen-of-scots ; factual dates only, original summaries.
Enigma property: https://www.tnmoc.org/notes-from-the-museum/2018/11/19/the-principle-of-the-enigma ; facts paraphrased, no prose or image import.
Original Curio Class practice sheets and drawn substitution shapes: CC BY 4.0. Instrument code MIT. No external corpus or licensed modern prose is bundled.

Hemstreet original key and inscription: https://www.gutenberg.org/ebooks/39789 ; public domain in the USA, verified 2026-11-05. Trinity independent confirmation: https://registers.trinitywallstreet.org/churchyard/history.php?id=350 .

Vicksburg context: https://www.nps.gov/vick/learn/historyculture/july-4-1863-slavery-ends-in-vicksburg.htm ; US government public-domain factual history. Checked against Smithsonian National Museum of American History Battle of Vicksburg.
